name: Chrono Haste
author: Elandor the Timemage
effects: Grants advantage on Dexterity saving throws
Extra action on each of its turns
materialText: A pinch of sand from an hourglass
upcastText: When cast at 5th level or higher, the duration increases by 1 minute per spell level above 4th.
restrictionText: This spell cannot be cast in an area of temporal distortion.
description: The target's perception of time shifts, allowing them to move swiftly. Their movement speed is doubled, they gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and they have an additional action on each of their turns that can be used to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action. When the spell ends, the target cannot move or take actions until after their next turn, as a wave of lethargy washes over them.

name: Veil of Echoes
author: Mystara Elderglow
effects: Creates an illusory duplicate of sounds heard within the area
Can mimic voices, footsteps, or other ambient sounds
materialText: a tiny silver bell and a piece of soft fabric
upcastText: Increase the radius by 10 feet for each spell slot level above 3rd.
restrictionText: Creatures that succeed on their Wisdom saving throw ignore the illusion.
description: Veil of Echoes allows the caster to create an auditory illusion that fills the area with copies of noises previously heard or created in the same place. These sounds might include conversations, ambient noises, or even footsteps. Anything that can be heard can be replicated within the sphere, creating confusion or amusement. The illusion persists for an hour, enough to potentially deceive those within its influence.

name: Spectral Fields
author: Arlin Moonshadow
materialText: A small shard of obsidian and a piece of chalk
upcastText: When cast with a spell slot of 5th level or higher, increase the radius by 10 feet for each slot level above 4th.
description: Spectral Fields blankets the chosen area in ethereal illusions, changing its appearance to resemble treacherous terrain filled with ghostly apparitions. Creatures within must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, they are disoriented, reducing their movement speed by half and granting attackers advantage on melee attacks against them. The illusory terrain also obscures vision causing disadvantage on perception checks for creatures relying on sight. Creatures can attempt the saving throw again at the end of each of their turns until the spell ends.

name: Veil of the Wisp
author: Aria Silversong
effects: Can produce ghostly whispers for distraction
area: Self and a 10-foot radius for whispers
materialText: A clove of shadowmoss, harvested under a new moon
upcastText: For each level above 3rd, the duration extends by 30 minutes.
restrictionText: Cannot be used in direct sunlight.
description: Veil of the Wisp shrouds the caster in an ethereal cloak of invisibility, rendering them unseen for the duration of the spell or until they attack or cast another spell. The caster can create ghostly whispers within a 10-foot radius that distract and confuse creatures, providing a unique edge in stealth situations. However, the spell's power wanes under the light of the sun, and it becomes ineffective.

name: Veil of Midnight
author: Aria Moonshadow
effects: Creates an area of supernatural darkness
materialText: a piece of obsidian and a drop of ink
upcastText: Increase the radius by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 4th.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in natural sunlight.
description: Veil of Midnight conjures an impenetrable darkness where neither mundane nor magical light can illuminate. This illusion also confounds darkvision. Creatures within the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of their turn or suffer a disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of their next turn, as illusory whispers sow confusion. The sphere remains anchored to the original point of casting, moving only if a mobile object is targeted as its center.

name: Celestial Watch
author: Arannis Starseer
effects: Highlight fiends in a soft glow
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in areas of total darkness
description: You call upon the luminous power of the stars to reveal hidden divine or fiendish presences. Any celestial entities obscured by magic or hiding are revealed, shimmering with astral light. Fiends in the area are outlined in a faint halo, though this does not dispel any invisibility effects they may possess. Any creature affected must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become visibly outlined, hindering their stealth and making them easier to track.

name: Twilight's Whisper
author: Mystra
materialText: A small piece of obsidian and a drop of shadow oil
upcastText: When cast with a higher-level spell slot, you can target one additional creature within range for each slot level above 3rd.
restrictionText: The spell ends if the target suffers damage from any source.
description: You weave a shadowy thread around a creature's mind, charming them and masking your presence. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you and unable to see or hear you, effectively rendering you invisible and silent to them. If the target takes any damage, the spell ends immediately. While charmed in this way, the target views you as a trusted friend and ally.

name: Luminous Lattice
author: Galen the Radiant
effects: Creates a lattice of light that restrains movement
Deals radiant damage to evil-aligned creatures
materialText: A small crystal prism
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 3rd, increase the damage by 1d6
restrictionText: Only affects creatures capable of being restrained
description: The caster projects a lattice made from interwoven strands of light that glows with radiant power. All creatures within the area must make a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained by the lattice. Evil-aligned creatures take additional radiant damage, as the dazzling light sears their corrupt spirits. The lattice glows brightly, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The caster can move the lattice up to 10 feet on each of their turns as part of their action while maintaining concentration.

name: Blizzard Barrage
author: Mystara Coldwink
effects: Creates a storm of ice and wind
materialText: A shard of ice and a pinch of salt
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 5th, the damage increases by 1d8.
description: You summon a swirling blizzard centered on a point you choose within range. The icy winds and sharp shards of ice lash out at creatures in the area. Creatures within the sphere must make a Constitution saving throw, suffering 6d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The ground becomes covered in a slick layer of ice, making it difficult terrain for the duration.

name: Vortex of Echoes
author: Mystara Windreader
materialText: a small silver bell and a tuning fork
upcastText: Each spell slot level above 5th increases the damage by 1d8.
description: You create a swirling vortex of haunting echoes and debilitating sounds that disorients and damages your foes. Within the chosen area, creatures hear terrifying whispers and echoes of their own thoughts, making it difficult for them to focus. Each creature within the area must make a Wisdom saving throw or take 6d8 psychic damage, halved on a successful save. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also disoriented, making all attack rolls and ability checks at disadvantage until the spell ends. The caster envisions the sound using the silver bell and harmonizes it using the tuning fork, imbuing the area with this potent auditory illusion.

name: Sylvan Echo
author: Aeliana the Whisperer
materialText: a silver leaf
upcastText: Increase the radius by 10 feet and the number of targets increases by one for each slot level above 3rd.
restrictionText: Only usable in natural or semi-natural environments.
description: You weave an enchantment using the essence of the forest, causing echoes of whispers and rustling leaves to confuse and mislead creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target becomes dazed, unable to distinguish friend from foe, and has disadvantage on attack rolls. The spell causes illusions of friendly creatures or animals, further confusing the affected. Each round, an affected creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Chrono Surge
author: Arlin Firestorm
effects: A rapid acceleration of time for the target
Grants additional action during the target’s turn
materialText: A silver pocket watch worth at least 50 gold pieces
upcastText: When cast with a higher-level spell slot, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
restrictionText: Cannot be used on constructs or undead.
description: Chrono Surge allows you to accelerate time for a willing creature, granting it an additional action during its turn for the spell's duration. The effects only apply to actions taken on the creature's turn and do not stack with other speed effects. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist the acceleration if unwilling. The spell cannot affect constructs or undead, as they are immune to the temporal manipulation effects of Chrono Surge.

name: Soulfire Envelopment
author: Mystra Elderglow
materialText: A charred bone wrapped in ash-stained silk
upcastText: For each slot level above 4th, increase the fire and necrotic damage by 1d8.
restrictionText: Creatures immune to fire or necrotic damage are unaffected.
description: You call forth spectral flames infused with the essence of necrosis, causing a swirling inferno to engulf an area. Any creature within the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 fire damage and 2d8 necrotic damage, or half as much on a successful one. The flames provide an eerie, flickering light, casting shadows tinged with ethereal darkness.

name: Celestial Quake
author: Elysia Brightstar
materialText: A shard of glowing crystal from a celestial being
upcastText: Increase damage by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5th.
restrictionText: Can only be cast under an open sky.
description: The caster channels divine power to invoke a radiant burst of energy, causing the ground to tremble beneath a chosen point within range. All creatures within the area of effect must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes radiant damage and is knocked prone, and blinded until the start of the caster's next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and avoids the other effects.

name: Astral Guardian
author: FantasySpellCrafter
materialText: A small star-shaped crystal
upcastText: Increase protection layers and guardian's attack by 1d6 for each level above 4th.
description: You conjure a spectral guardian in a location within range. The guardian protects allies within a 10-foot radius, granting them a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws. At the start of your turn, the guardian can make a ranged attack against a creature of your choice within 60 feet, dealing 4d6 radiant damage on a hit. The guardian evaporates if you lose concentration.

name: Eternal Flame of the Phoenix
author: Arannis the Pyromancer
effects: Ignites a target with mystical flames
These flames cannot be extinguished by non-magical means
materialText: A phoenix feather
upcastText: Increase damage by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5th.
description: Conjure a blazing fire from the essence of a phoenix, enveloping the target in azure flames. The affected creature suffers 6d6 fire damage immediately and endures 3d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. If the target succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw, the immediate damage is halved and the ongoing damage is avoided. The flames illuminate a 20-foot radius in bright light and double that in dim light.

name: Ethereal Echoes
author: Aria Whisperwind
upcastText: For each slot level above 4th, increase damage by 1d8.
description: Unleash haunting echoes from a parallel ethereal plane, causing a shimmering disturbance that disorients and damages. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 5d8 psychic damage, as distorted echoes manifest around them, affecting their perception of time. On a failed save, creatures also experience a -2 penalty to attack rolls and saving throws until the spell ends. The area becomes difficult terrain as the ground shimmers with ethereal energy.

name: Temporal Echo
author: Arcanist Llewyn
materialText: a silver hourglass filled with diamond dust
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 4th, increase the damage by 1d8.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in an area warded by a permanent anti-magic effect.
description: Temporal Echo creates shimmering illusions that ripple through time across a 20-foot radius within range. Each affected creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 10d8 psychic damage as it experiences echoes from alternative timelines. While the spell persists, affected creatures are disoriented, suffering disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws, until the spell ends. The silver hourglass used for this spell absorbs the flow of these echoes, allowing the caster to manipulate time's fabric for a short period.

name: Veil of Omens
author: Lorem Shadowweaver
materialText: A small piece of an oracle's robe
upcastText: For each slot level above 4th, increase the duration by 30 minutes.
restrictionText: Caster must have a proficiency in Insight or History.
description: Upon casting Veil of Omens, the caster enters a trance-like state, gaining flashes of possible futures and heightened awareness of their surrounding area. This confers an advantage on all Wisdom checks related to perception and insight. Additionally, once during the spell's duration, the caster can ask a single yes or no question about a specific course of action to gain a cryptic but truthful answer from the DM.

name: Gloomweaver's Embrace
author: Elaine Shadowmancer
effects: Grants invisibility in dim or dark environments
Inflicts necrotic damage upon physical contact
area: Self (In 20 feet radius of darkness, if available)
materialText: A pinch of grave soil mixed with ink
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 4th, the spell increases dark radius by 5 feet and adds 1d8 necrotic damage.
restrictionText: Caster must be in a dimly lit area or complete darkness to cast.
description: Harness the shadows to become an unseen entity in dimly lit environments. While cloaked, any creature that touches the caster suffers severe necrotic damage. Ideal for stealth operations and ambushes, this magic lends necromantic power to those who thrive in darkness.

name: Ethereal Web
author: Mystara the Weave-Seer
materialText: A strand of spider silk and a piece of ghostly essence
upcastText: For each spell slot above 4th level, the area increases by 5 feet.
restrictionText: Fails to ensnare incorporeal or ethereal creatures.
description: You conjure an ethereal web that springs forth from a point within range. The web fills a 20-foot cube and is anchored between two solid masses or layered across a flat surface, creating a complex and intricate barrier. Each creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained as long as it remains in the webs or until it breaks free. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer restrained. The ethereal strands slightly shift between the material and ethereal planes, causing minor confusion and slowing those who tread within.

name: Veil of Shifting Shadows
author: Aeloria Nightwhisper
materialText: a shard of obsidian and a pinch of grave dust
upcastText: For each level above 3rd, the area increases by an additional 5 feet.
description: Veil of Shifting Shadows conjures a mystical fog filled with swirling shadows that confuse and disorient any creature within its bounds. For the duration, the area is heavily obscured. Creatures within the area must make a Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks. Additionally, any creature attempting to attack from within or into the area makes attacks with disadvantage.

name: Celestial Veil
author: Aria Moonwhisper
effects: Grants resistance to radiant and necrotic damage
Provides a bonus to Wisdom saving throws
materialText: A piece of silk imbued with starlight, worth at least 50 gp
upcastText: When cast with a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast on creatures immune to radiant damage.
description: A shimmering veil of celestial energy envelops the target, imbuing them with the protective essence of the heavens. While the veil is active, the target has resistance to radiant and necrotic damage, and gains a +1 bonus to Wisdom saving throws. The veil glimmers softly, casting faint starlight within a 5-foot radius.

name: Etherial Chains
author: Lyrus the Enchanter
materialText: A small piece of chain
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 3rd, you can target one additional creature.
restrictionText: Cannot affect creatures that are immune to being restrained.
description: You summon chains of ethereal force that bind a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained for the duration. While restrained in this way, the creature has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. The chains are insubstantial, causing no damage but rendering the target immobile. The creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success.

name: Whispering Shadows
author: Aran Lightweaver
materialText: A piece of obsidian and a raven's feather
upcastText: Increase the radius of the spell by 10 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You summon a dark aura where shadows whisper chilling secrets. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be silenced and frightened for the duration. Silenced creatures cannot speak or use verbal components in spellcasting. Frightened creatures must use their movement to get as far from the center of the area as possible. Affected creatures can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on themselves on a success. Creatures that can't hear are immune to this spell.

name: Sylvan Whispers
author: Eldrinna Moonshadow
materialText: A sprig of mistletoe and a drop of fey honey
targets: All creatures of choice within radius
upcastText: For each spell level above 3rd, the radius increases by 10 feet.
description: The caster whispers words imbued with fey enchantments, sending a soothing wave through the air. Creatures within the area of effect hear ephemeral melodies that charm and distract them, becoming more susceptible to persuasion and suggestion. Affected creatures must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed and unable to perceive any hostile actions during the spell's duration. This spell does not end if the charmed creatures take damage, but they can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

name: Astral Echoes
author: Mystra
materialText: a tiny silver bell, which vibrates softly during casting
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 3rd, increase the radius by an additional 10 feet.
restrictionText: Cannot affect creatures that are deafened.
description: Astral Echoes conjures faint, ethereal sounds within a specific area that mimic whispered conversations of celestial beings. These echoes subtly influence emotions, causing creatures within the area to experience either deep calm or unease, depending on the caster's intent. Creatures must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be subject to the chosen emotional effect; calm removes the frightened condition and unease imposes disadvantage on Charisma checks.

name: Wrath of the Thunderous Choir
author: Eldara Stormweaver
materialText: a silken ribbon tied in a loop and a silver bell
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 5th, the damage increases by 1d8.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast underground or in confined spaces.
description: Conjure a deafening thunderous roar that spills from a point within range, echoing with the might of a divine choir. Each creature in the sphere must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 thunder damage and becomes deafened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and is not deafened. The powerful cacophony cannot be contained in small spaces, and expansions can cause structural damage to nearby fragile objects.

name: Aegis of Elemental Balance
author: Eldarion the Arcane
effects: Grants resistance to one elemental damage type
Temporarily alters surroundings to favor chosen element
materialText: a small disk of copper inscribed with elemental symbols
targets: Caster and all allies within area
upcastText: For each level above 5th, select an additional elemental damage type to grant resistance to.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast while under the effects of a spell that specifically enhances a single element, such as 'Flame Shield'.
description: Aegis of Elemental Balance envelops the caster with protective energies attuned to one of the elemental planes: fire, water, earth, or air. The caster gains resistance to a chosen elemental damage type (fire, cold, acid, or lightning), and allies within the area benefit from subtle environmental changes that favor the chosen element (e.g., fire causes ambient temperatures to rise slightly, reducing natural cold effects). This balance ensures protection and harmony in the midst of elemental chaos.

name: Echoes of Eternity
author: Aria Moonwhisper
effects: Reveals faint imprints of past events
Allows limited communication with past spirits
materialText: A shard of crystal and a drop of dew collected at dawn
upcastText: For each level above 3rd, extend the duration by 5 minutes.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in areas consecrated or desecrated by holy or unholy rituals.
description: You reach out to the threads of time, unveiling the whispers and visions of events long past in the current location. As you attune to the area, faint echoes of historical occurrences play out in overlapping and ethereal displays. As a bonus action during the spell's duration, you can attempt to ask a simple question to the spirits tied to the location. They respond in brief, cryptic messages, shedding light on past secrets. These spirits can only reveal what they witnessed, oftentimes subject to their biases and limitations. A Wisdom saving throw is required for each question to establish a connection, based on the prominence and clarity of the event in question.

name: Eclipse Veil
author: Aria Moonshadow
effects: Creates an area of magical darkness
materialText: A small piece of obsidian and a pinch of soot
upcastText: For each spell level above 4th, the radius increases by 10 feet.
restrictionText: Cannot stack with other magical darkness spells.
description: Eclipse Veil shrouds an area in a deep, magical darkness that daylight cannot penetrate, dimming sound and muffling footsteps within. Creatures entering the sphere must make a Wisdom saving throw or have their senses dulled, imposing disadvantage on perception checks and attack rolls while inside. This veil wraps a cloak of shadow around the caster, granting advantage on stealth checks within the area radiated by the spell.

name: Veil of Shattered Light
author: Arcanist Elodia
materialText: a fragment of a mirror and a pinch of mist quartz
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, increase the radius by 10 feet for each slot level above 4th.
description: Veil of Shattered Light creates a 30-foot radius sphere of flickering spectral shards of light. Any creature entirely within the area perceives the world beyond as distorted, making it difficult to navigate or aim accurately. Affected creatures must make an Intelligence saving throw when they attempt to attack or cast spells targeting anything outside the sphere, taking a -2 penalty on the roll if they fail. All creatures entering or starting their turn within the sphere are subject to this effect. The illusion can be seen through by true seeing.

name: Ethereal Entanglement
author: Mira Galewind
materialText: a silver thread spun under a full moon
upcastText: Increases the radius by 5 feet for each level above 4th.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in areas of magical darkness.
description: You conjure ghostly chains that spring from the ground, attempting to ensnare creatures in a 15-foot radius within range. Each creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be restrained. While restrained in this way, a creature cannot move using teleportation. At the end of each of its turns, the restrained creature can make another Dexterity saving throw, freeing itself on a success. This magical essence prevents any teleportation effects for its duration.

name: Spectral Echo
author: Elaria Starwind
effects: Create a haunting duplicate of a sound
materialText: A tiny silver bell
upcastText: When cast with a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 10 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in an area of magical silence.
description: You create an illusory sound of your choice within range. The sound originates from a point you choose within range and can take the form of any sound you have heard, lasting the duration. Creatures in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw or become disoriented, taking 2d8 psychic damage on a failed save. On a success, they take half damage and are not disoriented. A disoriented creature falls prone. The sound can be as soft as a whisper or as loud as a roar, lasting as a constant tonal echo or an unsettling auditory apparition.

name: Eclipse of Shadows
author: Arcane Scholar Lyra Moonshadow
effects: Creates a temporary zone of dim light
Targets within the zone have disadvantage on perception checks
materialText: A shard of black onyx and a pinch of powdered nightshade
targets: Creatures and objects within the area
upcastText: Increases the duration by 10 minutes for each spell slot level above 4th.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast in an area of natural sunlight.
description: Eclipse of Shadows creates a zone of otherworldly dim light, casting twisted illusions and distorting perceptions within its confines. Shadows dance and shift, making it harder to discern details and identities. This effect imposes disadvantage on perception checks for all creatures within the area. Creatures and objects outside the zone cannot see into it clearly, as if peering through a thick mist. The spell does not affect creatures that rely on senses other than sight for perception.

name: Verdant Shackles
author: Sylvia Greenbark
upcastText: When cast with a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4th.
restrictionText: Affected creatures are restrained by magical vines.
description: You conjure thick, thorny vines in a location you can see within range. These vines bind up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within a 20-foot radius. Each target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 piercing damage and becomes restrained by the vines for the duration. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and is not restrained. While restrained, a creature takes 1d8 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC, freeing itself on a success. The vines wither away when the spell ends.

name: Echoes of the Past
author: Aria Lightweaver
materialText: A silver bell and a pinch of salt
upcastText: For each spell slot level above 4th, extend the duration by 10 minutes.
restrictionText: Can only reveal events that occurred up to 100 years ago.
description: With a whispered incantation and the ringing of a silver bell, the caster draws forth echoes of significant past events within the spell's area. Visual and auditory illusions replay scenes from up to a century ago, offering insights and secrets long buried. The quality of the replay depends on the strength of the events and any magical disturbances present.

name: Spectral Shield
author: Student of Arcane Studies
effects: Creates a shimmering barrier that absorbs damage from the first attack against the caster.
materialText: A small piece of reflective glass and a drop of your own blood.
upcastText: For each slot level above 2nd, increase the damage absorbed by 2.
description: A protective barrier that surrounds the caster and absorbs the energy of the next attack, potentially saving them from harm.

name: Ethereal Grasp
author: Adventuring Academy Student
effects: Transmutes the caster's hands into ethereal appendages, allowing the cast to grapple or disarm enemies without physical contact.
upcastText: When cast using a higher spell slot, increase the duration by 1 minute for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You channel your magical energy to create ethereal hands that can grapple or disarm an opponent from a distance. The target must make a Strength saving throw or become grappled by the ethereal grasp, unable to escape until the spell ends or they succeed on a Strength check against your spell save DC.

name: Echoing Blade
author: Adventuring Academy Student
effects: Creates a spectral sword that deals psychic damage and can target an additional enemy within range.
materialText: A shard of crystal and a drop of blood from a willing creature.
targets: One target, additional target if upcasted
upcastText: For each level above 3, target one additional creature within range.
description: You conjure a shimmering blade of pure psychic energy that can be hurled at a target, dealing 3d8 psychic damage. On a failed saving throw, the target also suffers disadvantage on their next attack roll.

name: Shadowstep
author: Adventuring Academy
effects: Allows the caster to teleport between shadows within range, becoming temporarily invisible.
upcastText: For each slot level above 2nd, increase the range by 10 feet.
description: The caster can step into a shadow and re-emerge from another shadow they can see within range. Upon teleporting, they become invisible until the start of their next turn. If the caster appears within 5 feet of an enemy, they must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage.

name: Celestial Veil
author: Adventuring Academy
effects: Grants a protective barrier that absorbs a portion of incoming damage and reflects radiant energy.
materialText: A small shard of clear quartz and a pinch of powdered starstone.
upcastText: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage reflection increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You surround yourself with a shimmering veil of celestial energy that absorbs up to 10 damage from attacks. In addition, when an enemy strikes you while this veil is active, they take radiant damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. The veil dissipates if it absorbs damage equal to or greater than its threshold.

name: Blazing Whirlwind
author: Adept Spellweaver
effects: Creates a swirling vortex of flames that damages and pushes creatures away.
materialText: A pinch of ash and a small piece of charcoal
upcastText: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4th.
description: You conjure a rotating column of fire that extends outward in a 20-foot radius. All creatures within the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, any creature that fails the save is pushed 10 feet away from the center of the whirlwind. The whirlwind persists for the duration, moving with you as you move.

name: Whispering Shadows
author: Adventuring Academy
effects: Create illusory shadows that obscure vision.
Target creatures within the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for the duration.
materialText: A small piece of black fabric
targets: Up to 5 creatures of your choice
upcastText: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
description: You conjure illusory shadows in a 15-foot cube within range, creating a disorienting environment. Creatures caught within the shadows must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they become frightened for the duration of the spell. While frightened, affected creatures must use their movement to flee from the shadows if able.

name: Ethereal Echo
author: ChatGPT
effects: Creates illusory duplicates of the caster that confuse and distract enemies.
materialText: A small mirror shard and a pinch of sand.
upcastText: Increase the radius by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
description: When you cast Ethereal Echo, shimmering illusory duplicates of yourself spring into existence, creating confusion among your foes. Each enemy that starts its turn within the area must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the enemy has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, as they struggle to distinguish the real you from your illusory copies.

name: Celestial Lantern
author: Student of the Arcane
effects: Creates a floating lantern that illuminates dark areas and can reveal hidden creatures.
materialText: A small piece of crystal and a drop of oil
targets: Points of light and hidden creatures
upcastText: For each slot level above 2nd, increase the radius by 10 feet.
description: You conjure a magical lantern that floats up to 60 feet away from you, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The lantern reveals invisible creatures and objects within its light. You can dismiss it as a bonus action.

name: Spectral Snare
author: Adept of the Arcane
effects: Restricts movement of a target, making it unable to take actions or move.
materialText: A strand of spider silk and a pinch of powdered silver.
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You conjure a ghostly net of energy that ensnares your target, restricting their movements and actions. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are restrained and unable to move, while on a successful save, they take half damage and are unaffected.

name: Frostfire Burst
author: Student Adventurer
effects: Deals cold and fire damage to enemies in an area
materialText: A piece of ice and a small ember
targets: Creatures of your choice within the area
upcastText: For each level above 3rd, increase damage by 1d8.
description: You conjure a burst of energy that combines the essence of frost and flame, creating a chilling yet searing explosion that erupts in a sphere centered on a point you choose within range.

name: Spectral Ward
author: Adventuring Academy Student
effects: Creates a protective barrier that negates the next 10 damage points dealt to the target.
materialText: A piece of crystal worth at least 5 gold pieces.
upcastText: For each slot level above 2nd, increase the damage negation by 5.
description: You conjure a spectral ward around a creature of your choice within range. This ethereal barrier absorbs the first 10 points of damage that the target would take. If the ward is not used by the time the spell ends, it dissipates harmlessly.

name: Veil of Eclipsing Shadows
author: Aria Moonglade
upcastText: Increase the area by 10 feet for each level above 4th.
restrictionText: Does not affect creatures with blindsight or true sight.
description: You create an area of shifting shadows and illusions that obscure the vision of those within it. All creatures in the area who fail a Wisdom saving throw perceive their surroundings as swirling, obscured darkness, effectively blinding them to everything outside of the veil. The affected creatures must use an action to make a renewed saving throw at the end of their turns to end the condition. The affected area becomes difficult terrain due to the disorienting shadows. This spell cannot penetrate magical or natural sources of light stronger than torchlight.

name: Echo of the Abyss
author: Novice Spellcaster
materialText: a shard of obsidian and a small piece of bone
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the necrotic damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.
description: Unleash a haunting echo that reverberates through the minds of creatures within range, causing them to suffer necrotic and psychic damage. On a failed Wisdom saving throw, affected creatures take 6d8 necrotic damage and 6d8 psychic damage, and they become Frightened until the spell ends. On a successful save, they take half damage and aren't Frightened. Creatures frightened by this spell have disadvantage on saving throws against it at the start of each of their turns.

name: Veil of Starlight
author: NoviceSpellCrafter
materialText: a small shard of obsidian and a pinch of silvery powder
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration increases by 30 minutes for each slot level above 3rd.
restrictionText: Cannot be cast while in direct sunlight.
description: You cloak yourself in an illusory veil of shimmering starlight, making you more personable and charismatic. For the duration, you gain advantage on Charisma-based ability checks and saving throws, and creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed for the duration of the spell. Creatures charmed in this way see you in an idealized light and are more amenable to your suggestions, provided they don't harm them. The effect ends early for an individual if they take damage.

name: Aegis of Veil
author: Novice Spell Inventor
upcastText: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radius of the ward increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You create a protective barrier that encircles you in a 10-foot radius, granting you and your allies within the area the benefits of invisibility against hostile creatures outside the barrier. In addition, this protective veil muffles sounds originating from inside, offering advantages on stealth checks. The barrier moves with you, and any creatures that leave the area of effect are no longer invisible. The spell ends early if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Searing Chains
author: Novice Spell Inventor
materialText: A small piece of iron chain and a pinch of sulfur
upcastText: For each slot level above 3rd, the damage increases by 1d6.
description: You conjure flaming chains that erupt from the ground in a 20-foot radius within range. Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 6d6 fire damage and be restrained by the chains for the duration. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is not restrained. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself from the chains. The chains emit dim light in a 20-foot radius.

name: Veil of Echoes
author: Novice Spell Creator
materialText: A small silver bell and a piece of fine cloth
upcastText: For each spell level above 4th, increase the area by an additional 10 feet.
restrictionText: Can only be cast in locations where sound is able to travel naturally.
description: You weave a layer of illusory echoes within a 30-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Until the spell ends, the area is filled with soft murmurs and echoes of indistinct conversations and laughter. Creatures within the area must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or believe the echoes to be distant social gatherings or events, compelling them to treat any encounters as amicable or trivial by default. The spell allows for seamless deceptive communications, granting advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made within the area.

name: Radiant Veil
author: Aria Lightweaver
materialText: a small silver mirror
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the radiant shield gains an additional 1d8 protection and deals 1d8 more damage for each slot level above 4th.
description: You envelop yourself and nearby allies in a shimmering veil of radiant light. Each affected creature gains a protective shield that grants temporary hit points equal to 3d8 at the start of each of their turns. Additionally, the first enemy who hits a shielded creature with a melee attack each turn takes 3d8 radiant damage. The radiant light also grants advantage on saving throws against fear effects.

name: Seismic Grasp
author: Novice Spell Inventor
materialText: a small piece of granite
upcastText: You can increase the damage by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You cause a violent tremor in the ground within range. All creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 3d8 bludgeoning damage and fall prone. The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain until the spell ends. Each creature that enters the area for the first time on their turn or ends their turn there must also succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 3d8 bludgeoning damage and fall prone. The tremors disrupt concentration on spells, forcing spellcasters in the area to make a concentration check if they are maintaining any spell effects.

name: Resonant Echo
author: Novice Spell Inventor
materialText: a small tuning fork
upcastText: For each spell slot above 2nd level, the thunder damage increases by 1d8.
description: A burst of thunderous sound erupts from a point you choose within range, each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the center of the area. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't pushed.

name: Veil of Refraction
author: Novice Spellcaster
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, increase the duration by 10 minutes for each slot level above 2nd.
description: You create an illusory veil that bends light around you and up to a number of creatures equal to your spellcasting ability modifier within 10 feet. This makes targets appear in slightly different positions than they actually are, granting them advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Attacks against targets inside the sphere have disadvantage as the distorted light makes it hard to gauge precise locations. The illusion emits no light and affects only sight.

name: Echoes of the Past
author: Novice Spell Inventor
materialText: a shard of ancient pottery or bone
upcastText: Increases the radius by 10 feet and the duration by 5 minutes for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You sense the lingering threads of the past, revealing significant events that transpired in the area. As you cast this spell, echoes from previous interactions, secrets, and moments of strong emotion manifest as faint images and whispers. This may include events such as battles, long-held conversations, or magical workings. The caster garners insight into the nature of these events and can identify any lingering magic. Useful for uncovering past secrets or detecting hidden spells. Faint echoes may also briefly provide warnings or guidance regarding the area’s history.

name: Luminous Chains
author: Adventurer's Codex
upcastText: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.
description: You summon chains of radiant light in a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d8 radiant damage and be restrained by the chains of light for the duration. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC to free itself. The chains emit bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

name: Veil of Fractured Light
author: Novice Spell Inventor
materialText: a shard of stained glass
upcastText: When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
description: A myriad of colors and lights twist within a 20-foot radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they are blinded and take 4d6 radiant damage. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and are not blinded. The sphere creates intricate patterns that obscure vision, granting advantage on deception checks within the area. The colors and patterns shift, creating an ever-changing landscape of light.
